name: Winter Palace Hotel
scope: Standing historic Winter Palace Hotel on Luxor’s Nile Corniche. Includes the three guest floors above the arcaded base, the main landing with paired stairs, and connected end and garden ranges of the old palace.
era: Standing historical hotel as documented before the 2026–27 restoration.

originalReview.notes: The original author claimed the photo as self-made at upload and added PD-self in the first follow-up edit. Reviewed the river façade, three upper levels, crown, regular balconies, terrace and double stair.

Library of Congress digital scan from the original dry plate glass negative, catalogued 1936. The exact photograph has no known restrictions and belongs to the collection dedicated by its rights holder. The archive’s prior-use exception discusses lantern slides used for books. This item is a glass camera negative. Used to confirm the projecting end and center ranges and the original entrance stair profile.

review.notes: Reviewed published Qualla images first. The exact Rowan original has a first-party public-domain dedication. A dedicated Library of Congress glass negative corroborates the older facade. Attribution-required images and images of other sites were excluded.
